# BizTrack – Business Manager

> All-in-one web and mobile app to manage a business, factory, or rental property: sales, stock, purchases, expenses, orders, services, team, and receipts. Works offline-first with optional Premium tier.

BizTrack (also published as Business Manager and My Factory) supports three workspace types — retail/wholesale Business, Factory production, and FlexRent rental — with shared core features for inventory, finance, multi-tenant teams, and B2B discovery between businesses.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Sign-in, sign-up, and product hero.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How user and business data is handled.
- [Browse Listings](/browse): Public discovery of rentals and listings.
- [Orders](/orders): B2B order placement, tracking, and disputes.
- [Resources](/resources): Practical editorial guides for small-business inventory, finance, customers, teams, and offline operations.

## Business Guides

- [Inventory Management for Small Business](/resources/inventory-management-for-small-business): Organizing stock, units, cycle counts, and purchasing decisions.
- [Small Business Cash Flow Management](/resources/small-business-cash-flow-management): Separating sales, collections, purchases, expenses, and debt repayments.
- [Customer Records and Repeat Sales](/resources/customer-records-repeat-sales): Building useful customer histories while protecting trust.
- [Team Accountability](/resources/team-accountability-small-business): Clear roles, daily records, fair review, and access controls.
- [Offline Business Records](/resources/offline-business-records-guide): Safe record keeping and synchronization during unreliable connectivity.

## Optional

- [Reset Password](/reset-password): Account recovery flow.
